blockers: CSRF-denied native POST requests are not audited because the CSRF filter is registered before the audit-writing mutation filter.

evidence.outcome: Passed 100/100 tests, 0 failures; native integration safely no-ops without FACTORIO_NATIVE_* on Windows.
Parser validates PE x64 and ELF x86_64 headers; cleanup is bounded.
Authenticated API, CSRF, and admin/owner authorization are present, but filter order lets CSRF rejection return before audit logging.
Native operations snapshot/revalidate compatibility, preserve ActiveSave, and atomically promote staged saves.

next_slice.summary: Ensure audit filter wraps CSRF validation for native mutation routes and add a denied-CSRF audit regression test, then rerun final QA.

result: QA passed PE/ELF architecture parsing, bounded cleanup, stopped/confirmation gates, compatibility revalidation, isolated staging/atomic promotion, and opt-in Linux round-trip coverage. One concrete defect remains: CSRF-denied native POST requests are not audited because NativeMapRoutes installs CsrfFilter before ApiMutationAuthorizationFilter, so CSRF short-circuits before the audit-writing filter.
